definitions.full: H5599. caphiyach I. [ סָפִיחַ ] noun [masculine] outpouring ?; — plural suffix הָאָרֶץ עֲפַר תִּשְׁטֹףסְֿפִיחֶיהָ Job 14:19 (si vera lectio) its outpourings sweep away the dust of the earth , so most, but dubious; Bu proposes * סְחִיפָה , compare סֹחֵף מָטָר Prov 28:3 . II. סָפִיחַ noun [masculine] growth from spilled kernels ((kernels) poured out , accidentally, in harvesting, according to most; Buhl Lex 13 and others think of additional growth, √ I. ספח ); — it is what springs up of itself in second year, and serves as food when no grain could be sown: absolute ׳ס 2Kin 19:29 = Isa 37:30 ; construct קְצִירְךָ סְפִיחַ Lev 25:5 ; suffix אֶתסְֿפִיחֶיהַ תִּקְצְרוּ 25:11 .
